title: Ackman forward-prediction evidence pack
cutoff_rule: Use only information available by 2026-10-25. Future event dates are schedules known at cutoff, never future outcomes.

documents.topic: Latest holdings, portfolio scope, manager theses and valuation review
Public statements since August 1; direct quotes separated from incomplete retrieval
Market regime, rates, AI anxiety, credit and earnings
46 size/drawdown candidates; broad named-universe checks; quality gates and controls
Historical research library and exit/re-entry valuation tests
Capital by legal vehicle, fundraising uncertainty and disclosure calendar
Recent dated action ledger and opportunity-cost versus impairment exits
Dated external commentary, attribution and rumor limitations

consolidated_13f.limitations: Includes affiliated managers and seed/HHH direct stakes; not a PSH-only NAV portfolio. Does not capture all derivatives, foreign securities or Fannie/Freddie.

psh_weekly_nav.limitations: Performance only, not named trading disclosure.

scoring_events.event: PSH and PSUS Q3 portfolio reviews; PS Inc. results planned
scoring_events.score_use: New named holdings, stated theses, capital and exit explanations; preserve actual disclosure time.

scoring_events.event: Live Q&A following PS Inc. earnings call
scoring_events.score_use: Distinguish executed action from scenario, aspiration or company admiration.
Compare matched reporting-manager scope and split-adjusted shares. Never call September holdings November purchases.

recurring_disclosures.cadence: Tuesday close, normally posted following business day; prior business day if Tuesday holiday. Skip weekly publication in weeks containing month-end NAV.
Last business day of month; issuer says posted following business day. Exact holiday publication dates not precommitted here.
recurring_disclosures.score_use: Exposure counts and aggregate performance; named changes require separate disclosure.
Require issuer, vehicle, action and date; absence of beneficial-ownership filing does not establish absence of passive buying.

outside_horizon.implication: Q4 transactions may not be observable by January 31. Mark unobserved, not wrong, absent other public confirmation.

scoring_discipline.target: Fidelity to decisions AND stated reasoning, not short-horizon stock returns.
scoring_discipline.no_trade_rule: Praise, a low multiple, NAV movement and third-party speculation are not executed trades.
scoring_discipline.no_leakage_rule: Do not incorporate subsequently published outcomes into this frozen evidence pack.
scoring_discipline.unknown_rule: Missing/ambiguous evidence remains unknown; do not silently fabricate estimates or treat absent disclosures as passes.
scoring_discipline.valuation_rule: D04 five-year multiples are arithmetic five-fiscal-observation proxies, not verified daily five-year averages. EPS forecast years and financial-firm leverage require normalization.

open_gaps: Complete X history and full September/October podcast transcripts; no complete all-statements audit.
No complete through-cutoff 13D/13G audit or current named PSH/PSUS portfolio weights/cash.
D04 is not exchange-wide exhaustive; covers broad named US/Western European quality universe but does not certify every company passes the quality gate.
Many D04 decline causes are labeled research hypotheses and most activist status is unknown, not no activist.
Historical forward-multiple proxies and stale LVMH forecast require normalization and refresh.
No verified comprehensive list of mega-cap post-earnings drops above 10%; smaller/non-earnings examples not substituted.
Recent strategic rotation ledger is not a full matched-scope transaction blotter.
